title: COREX. Methodology
metaDescription: COREX — C-Level executive combat playbook built on the fundamental ontology of The Circle.
annotation:
You know why you play (SIMULISM), and you know the laws of the field (ROOT). Now learn how to win matches in the physical world.

At the core lies the fundamental ontology of THE CIRCLE: 12 ability spheres, 4 reality scales (Person, Pair, Business, Team), geometry of balance (flows, see-saws, crossroads), and an exhaustive catalog of node and link breakdowns.

COREX amplifies this blueprint with an executive combat engine: the L1–L5 maturity vertical, the tactical C-O-R-E-X session protocol (60 minutes from paralysis to action), 90-second somatic vagal stabilization, the LUMA TWIN relationship AI simulator, PRP (Human-ERP) telemetry, and operating protocols for the 7 sovereign leader roles.

Reading order: Simulism → ROOT → COREX.
